name: desktop
description: Native Windows desktop shell for the ProjectRD platform app (loads the live web app, adds native printing + OS-level features).

scripts.build:shell: esbuild src/shell/index.ts src/shell/popup.ts --bundle --outdir=dist/shell && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('dist/shell',{recursive:true});for(const f of ['index.html','index.css','popup.html','popup.css','logo.png'])fs.copyFileSync('src/shell/'+f,'dist/shell/'+f)"
scripts.build: pnpm build:main && pnpm build:preload && pnpm build:shell
